description: Source code for terrain and building rule management in the Wesnoth game, including terrain cache building, rule validation, rotation, and application logic.

classes.name: locator_string_initializer
classes.description: Helper class for initializing image locators with optional location context.

classes.name: terrain_builder::rule_image
classes.description: Represents an image rule with position, layer, and base coordinates.

classes.name: terrain_builder::tile
classes.description: Represents a map tile with images, flags, and adjacency info.

classes.name: terrain_builder::tilemap
classes.description: Manages a grid of tiles, providing access and reset functionality.

classes.name: terrain_builder
classes.description: Main class for building and managing terrain and building rules.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Constructs an image locator based on the string and optional location.

methods.name: add_image_to_cache
methods.description: Adds images to cache based on time of day and iterator.

methods.name: rebuild_cache
methods.description: Rebuilds image cache for a tile based on time of day.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears tile data including images and flags.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all tiles in the tilemap.

methods.name: on_map
methods.description: Checks if a location is within map bounds.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a tile at a given location, with bounds assertion.

methods.name: get_terrain_at
methods.description: Retrieves terrain images at a location for a specific time of day and terrain type.

methods.name: update_animation
methods.description: Updates animation frames for all tiles at a location.

methods.name: rebuild_terrain
methods.description: Rebuilds terrain images for a specific location.

methods.name: rebuild_all
methods.description: Rebuilds all terrain data and caches.

methods.name: rule_valid
methods.description: Validates a building rule by checking referenced images.

methods.name: start_animation
methods.description: Starts animation for images in a rule.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates terrain constraints and images by a specified angle.

methods.name: replace_token
methods.description: Replaces tokens in strings or rule components.

methods.name: rotate_rule
methods.description: Creates a rotated version of a building rule.

methods.name: add_images_from_config
methods.description: Adds images to rules from configuration data.

methods.name: add_constraints
methods.description: Adds terrain constraints to a set based on location and config.

methods.name: parse_mapstring
methods.description: Parses a string map into terrain constraints and anchors.

methods.name: add_rule
methods.description: Adds a building rule to the ruleset if valid.

methods.name: add_rotated_rules
methods.description: Adds multiple rotated versions of a rule based on rotation data.

methods.name: parse_config
methods.description: Parses terrain rules and constraints from configuration.

methods.name: terrain_matches
methods.description: Checks if a terrain letter matches a terrain type string.

methods.name: rule_matches
methods.description: Checks if a rule matches a location based on constraints and probability.

methods.name: apply_rule
methods.description: Applies a rule's images and flags to a location.

methods.name: get_constraint_adjacents
methods.description: Counts adjacent tiles matching rule constraints.

methods.name: get_constraint_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of a constraint, considering border status.

methods.name: build_terrains
methods.description: Builds terrain adjacency caches and border info.

methods.name: update_animation
methods.description: Updates current frames of animated images at a location.

methods.name: rebuild_terrain
methods.description: Rebuilds terrain images for a specific location.

methods.name: rebuild_all
methods.description: Rebuilds all terrain data and caches.
